Value and year match the digitised Chandler file.

Exact match for the city proper.

checks.item: Obelisco de Buenos Aires: completed 1936, height 67.5 m, at -34.6036, -58.3817 (documented)
checks.found: es: 'Fue construido en 1936'; built 20 March to 23 May 1936; 'Su altura es de 67,5 m'. en: coordinates 34°36'13"S 58°22'54"W (-34.6036, -58.3817).
checks.detail: Year, height and coordinates match. (The English infobox shows 71.5 m while its own text says 67.5 m.)

checks.item: Torre Espacial: completed 1985, height 200 m, at -34.6725, -58.4497 (documented)
checks.found: en: 200 m 'not including antenna', completed May 1981, inaugurated 9 July 1985, coordinates 34°40'21"S 58°26'59"W. es: '208 m de estructura y 20 m de antena. 228 m totales', built 1980-1982, opened 9 July 1985. City government page: 'La Torre tiene 208 metros'; 'inaugurada el 9 de julio de 1985'.
checks.detail: Changed height_m from 200 to 208 (city government page and Spanish Wikipedia agree on 208 m for the structure; 200 m is only on English Wikipedia), put the city page first in source, and added a note that 1985 is the opening year while the structure was erected in 1980-1982. Year and coordinates left as they were.

checks.item: Torre Le Parc: completed 1996, height 157.9 m, at -34.5751, -58.4214 (documented)
checks.found: CTBUH: completion 1996, 157.9 m, 51 floors. English Wikipedia: developed 1991-1995, 'completion in 1995', coordinates 34°34'30.6"S 58°25'17.2"W (-34.5752, -58.4214). Spanish Wikipedia: built 1989-1994, 'inaugurada en 1994', 158 m.
checks.detail: Height and coordinates match, but the completion year is 1996 (CTBUH), 1995 (English Wikipedia) or 1994 (Spanish Wikipedia) and I could not settle it. Kept 1996 and confidence documented because the cited CTBUH record says so; added a note listing the three dates.

checks.item: 1857: First railway in Argentina (29 August 1857, Estación del Parque to La Floresta)
checks.found: 'El 29 de agosto de 1857 partió el primer tren argentino desde la Estación del Parque, ubicada en las cercanías de la actual Plaza Lavalle, hasta la estación La Floresta'.
checks.detail: Date and description match the cited page.

checks.found: 'In 1880, after the Argentine Civil War, Buenos Aires was federalized and split from Buenos Aires Province.'
checks.detail: Year and description match the cited page.

summary: Eight of 10 items matched their sources, including the city statistics office table for 1855 and 1936. Torre Espacial was corrected from 200 m to 208 m, and the completion year of Torre Le Parc was flagged because CTBUH and the two Wikipedias give 1996, 1995 and 1994.
